summary: This Form 6-K filed by Transportadora de Gas del Sur S.A. (an Argentine gas transporter) reports the Argentine Ministry of Economy's approval of the company's request to adhere to the Incentive Regime for Large Investments (RIGI) for a single project: the expansion of a gas pipeline. The project involves a USD 550 million investment to add 14 MMm³/d capacity. This is a regulatory/governmental approval regarding a capital project, not a special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
